folkways.combat.help: Select 1–8 loaded residents and create a squad, or choose an existing squad. One point is a guard post; 2–16 points make a looping patrol. Close the book to move, then reopen it to add more points. Commands are released on restart.
folkways.combat.supply_help: Equipment comes from the assigned profile. Each resident collects their own physical set.
folkways.combat.error.rejected: Cannot apply this order. Check that the squad, residents and positions are still valid.
folkways.combat.error.members: Choose 1–8 distinct loaded residents held by this colony, in the same realm.
folkways.combat.error.destination: Use a loaded, dry place to stand in the same realm, within 128 blocks. Every formation slot needs room.
folkways.combat.error.group: Choose a valid actual squad belonging to this colony.
folkways.rts.group_card: Group %1$s: %2$s/%3$s available. %1$s recalls; Ctrl+%1$s replaces or disbands identical members.
folkways.rts.stop.tooltip: Cancel this squad's route and pursuit; hold position
folkways.rts.release_control.tooltip: Release selected residents from RTS control
folkways.rts.rest_note: Controlled residents wait when tired. Releasing them lets them rest; too little rest lowers mood.
folkways.rts.suspend_note: Closing V or switching tools suspends RTS input. Accepted group orders keep running; reopen to resume. Temporary selections without a group are released.
folkways.rts.help: Select by left-clicking or dragging. Right-click ground to order; Ctrl+right-click to append. Hold Ctrl to review committed route history (not a draft); when open, click a visible marker to append or close. Middle-drag pans, Alt+middle-drag orbits, the wheel zooms, and Walk/Jump/Sneak move the camera.
folkways.rts.syncing: Command not sent: synchronizing colony state or busy. Try again shortly.
folkways.rts.ground_required: Choose loaded, dry standing ground in the current realm.
folkways.rts.selection_limit: Select up to %s residents per order. The selection was not changed.
folkways.rts.route_full: Up to %s waypoints; Ctrl+RMB an earlier marker to close the loop.
folkways.rts.route_closed: This patrol is closed. Right-click ground to replace its route.
folkways.rts.cycle_too_short: A patrol loop needs two distinct points. Add another, then click an earlier marker.
folkways.rts.route_mode_mismatch: Movement modes differ. Right-click ground to start a new route.
